paragraphs.source_en: This book is now more than twenty-five years old. Throughout these years, many hundreds of people have contributed to its reach and longevity. Here I want to single out just a few. Monica Wood edited every version of this book until it came out in 1992. Rhoda Walter was an impeccable researcher and supporter in that same period of time. The New Road Map Foundation, staffed entirely by volunteers, is the educational and charitable organization we created in 1984 to disseminate this—and other—transformational tools; the NRM team dedicated itself to bringing the nine-step program to hundreds of thousands of people in myriad ways.

paragraphs.source_en: Chris Ryba worked as my trusty and indispensable assistant editor throughout 2017. When we met we discovered several shared passions: *Your Money or Your Life*, for starters, smart personal financial strategies in general, and the power of conversation to transform lives. His millennial’s-eye view on the world has been indispensable. We’ve wrestled this update into shape together, and he has edited every version of every rewrite of every chapter with clarity, intelligence, and good cheer.
